title: A response can leave memory
hook: Predict the interaction and trace one immune step.

knows: The immune system includes cells and signaling molecules.
doesNotKnow: Some activated B cells become memory cells that can contribute to a faster response upon a later encounter with the relevant antigen. Protection varies by context.

misconception: The immune response consists of one cell acting alone.
objective: Explain the stated interaction in a simplified immune response.

claims.text: Question, stage and reveal: After an adaptive response, which B-cell descendants can support a faster response to a later encounter with the same antigen? Some activated B cells become memory cells that can contribute to a faster response upon a later encounter with the relevant antigen. Protection varies by context.
Icons show one selected interaction rather than all required signals, and are not to scale.
Recall: Which B-cell descendant can support a faster later response to an antigen? Memory B cells can respond to a later encounter with the relevant antigen.

recall.question: Which B-cell descendant can support a faster later response to an antigen?
recall.why: Memory B cells can respond to a later encounter with the relevant antigen.
